views.name: eda_per_feature_version
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  name AS name,
  version AS version,
  feature AS feature,
  type AS type,
  range AS range,
  drop_user AS drop_user,
  drop_correlation AS drop_correlation,
  target AS target
FROM eda
views.description: Normalized EDA rows: one row per (name, version, feature) exposing EDA attributes. Use this to join EDA metadata to solutions, aggregate feature counts, or filter features by drop flags or type. | Use for: List features for a given problem/version; Count features by type per version; Filter features that were marked dropped by user or correlation

views.name: feature_importance_by_step
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  name AS name,
  version AS version,
  step AS step,
  feature AS feature,
  importance AS importance
FROM feature_importance
views.description: Per-feature importance scores at the (name, version, step, feature) grain. Exposes raw importance measure and is useful to aggregate, rank, or join with EDA and solution records. | Use for: Which features are most important in a given step/version; Trend of feature importance across steps; Aggregate importance across features or steps

views.name: model_scores_long
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  name AS name,
  version AS version,
  step AS step,
  model AS model,
  train_score AS train_score,
  test_score AS test_score
FROM model_score
views.description: All model scores at (name, version, step, model) grain with train and test scores. Use when comparing models, selecting best model per step/version, or plotting score distributions. | Use for: Find best test_score per model/version/step; Compare train vs test scores (overfitting detection); Aggregate scores across models or steps

views.name: model_best_per_step_ranked
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  name AS name,
  version AS version,
  step AS step,
  model AS model,
  train_score AS train_score,
  test_score AS test_score,
  RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY name, version, step ORDER BY test_score DESC) AS model_rank
FROM model_score
views.description: Rank models per (name, version, step) by test_score descending and expose a rank column. Useful for downstream Top-K filters (WHERE rank <= K) to select top models per step/version. | Use for: Top-N models by test_score per step/version; Identify rank-1 model per step/version; Compare ranks across steps or versions

views.name: solution_summary
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  name AS name,
  version AS version,
  correlation AS correlation,
  nb_model AS nb_model,
  nb_feature AS nb_feature,
  score AS score,
  test_size AS test_size,
  resampling AS resampling
FROM solution
views.description: One row per solution (name, version) summarizing chosen solution attributes: correlation, nb_model, nb_feature, score, test_size, resampling. Use as a base for joins to problem or to compare solution summaries across versions. | Use for: Compare solution scores across versions; Join solution metadata to problem or EDA to see feature counts; Filter solutions by score or number of models/features

views.name: problem_with_latest_solution
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.name AS name,
  p.path AS path,
  p.type AS type,
  p.target AS target,
  s.version AS version,
  s.correlation AS correlation,
  s.nb_model AS nb_model,
  s.nb_feature AS nb_feature,
  s.score AS score,
  s.test_size AS test_size,
  s.resampling AS resampling
FROM problem p
JOIN (
  SELECT
    name,
    version,
    correlation,
    nb_model,
    nb_feature,
    score,
    test_size,
    resampling
  FROM solution
  WHERE (name, version) IN (
    SELECT name, MAX(version) FROM solution GROUP BY name
  )
) s ON p.name = s.name
views.description: Denormalized join of problem to its latest solution version per problem. Exposes problem metadata together with the most recent solution summary. Use when you need current solution attributes alongside problem info. | Use for: Show latest solution metadata for each problem; List problems with their current best solution score; Filter problems by solution attributes (score, nb_model)

views.name: feature_importance_aggregated_by_version
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  name AS name,
  version AS version,
  feature AS feature,
  COUNT(importance) AS importance_count,
  AVG(importance) AS importance_avg,
  SUM(importance) AS importance_sum,
  MIN(importance) AS importance_min,
  MAX(importance) AS importance_max
FROM feature_importance
GROUP BY name, version, feature
views.description: Aggregate feature importance per (name, version, feature): exposes sum, avg, min, max and count of importance across steps. Useful to identify consistently important features across steps for a given version. | Use for: Which features are most important on average for a version; Stability of feature importance across steps; Select features with high aggregated importance

views.name: model_importance_by_model
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  name AS name,
  version AS version,
  step AS step,
  model AS model,
  importance AS importance
FROM model_importance
views.description: Raw model_importance rows at (name, version, step, model) grain showing importance measure. Use to inspect model-level importance or join to model_score/model metadata. | Use for: Compare model_importance to model_score; Aggregate model importances across steps; Identify models with consistently high importance

views.name: models_with_scores_and_importance
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  ms.name AS name,
  ms.version AS version,
  ms.step AS step,
  ms.model AS model,
  ms.train_score AS train_score,
  ms.test_score AS test_score,
  mi.importance AS importance
FROM model_score ms
LEFT JOIN model_importance mi
  ON ms.name = mi.name
  AND ms.version = mi.version
  AND ms.step = mi.step
  AND ms.model = mi.model
views.description: Denormalized view joining model_score and model_importance at matching (name, version, step, model), exposing scores and importance together. Useful to correlate importance with model performance. | Use for: Assess relationship between model importance and test_score; Select models with high importance and high test_score; Report models with missing importance annotations

views.name: latest_solution_version_per_problem_rank
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  name AS name,
  version AS version,
  correlation AS correlation,
  nb_model AS nb_model,
  nb_feature AS nb_feature,
  score AS score,
  test_size AS test_size,
  resampling AS resampling,
  RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY name ORDER BY version DESC) AS latest_version_rank
FROM solution
views.description: Rank solution versions per problem by version descending to expose latest_version_rank = 1 rows. Use downstream WHERE latest_version_rank = 1 to pick the latest solution per problem deterministically. | Use for: Select the latest solution per problem; Compare latest vs previous solution versions; Filter solutions to the most recent version for analysis
